method: Executed the official offline client on dedicated Xvfb97 using software OpenGL and an original local resource pack. Captured its real server-list framebuffer after a localhost status response. Only numeric samples from the original test glyphs are retained; screenshots/game assets stay private.
scope: One original opaque tall bitmap at scale2, two text lines and underline. Confirms supplied-font placement and that the earlier underline remains above later-line ink in this case. Oversized upward ink is visible natively but remains deliberately clipped by the viewer; this probe is not full GPU/font/atlas/alpha/depth certification.
